All 4 timeframes are above EMA9+21. Macro is firmly risk-on — Tech +1.21%, VIX -5.87%, QQQ +1.05%. News backdrop has improved: Core PPI came in soft (0.1% vs 0.3% forecast), easing inflation fears. However, 4H RSI at 76.40 is a hard NO_LONGS flag per system rules, and a red BT signal is appearing at the highs. The key question is whether this is a bull trend continuation (price breaks 26,000) or MEAN_REVERT_OVERBOUGHT exhaustion. No more news risk today — the RSI flag is the sole blocker. WAIT for either (1) 26,000 breakout + RSI reset below 73, or (2) 15m body close below 25,750 + red BT for a short.
